chitchat: You can't be here. Well. You can be there. Not here.
I'm not meant to talk to you much.
Ambler does the talking. I do the standing.
It's nothing personal. It's really genuinely nothing personal.
Don't go round the back. There's nothing round the back. Just do not.
description:
A big young man standing where the road shoulder gives out, holding a long-handled shovel he isn't using for anything. He watches you the entire way in, and when you get close he looks at your hands, and then at your face, and then decidedly at the horizon.

He has clearly been told what to say. You can see him going and getting it.

bye.text:
"Right. Yes. Safe road."

He says it a beat after you have already turned away, to your back, and means it.

enjoy.text:
"No." He turns the shovel over in his hands. "I'm not good at it. Ambler is good at it. She can say no to somebody and they go away feeling like they were given something."

"I came here myself, you know. Off the road. Fourteen years old with nothing." He stops dead, hearing himself. "And that's also not something I'm meant to say, so."

He puts the shovel down, blade first, and stands on the shoulder of the road looking at the salt in the south, and doesn't say anything else for a while.

options.label: You don't seem to enjoy this.

like.text:
"It's good," he says, and then his face does something complicated, "no, I'm not, I'm not meant to say what it's like, I'm meant to say that you don't belong here."

A pause.

"You don't belong here."

He looks unhappy about having said the first bit and unhappier about the second, and doesn't take either of them back.

root.first: "You can't come in." He gets it out fast, and it has plainly been practised. "That is, ah. That's all of it, really. That's the whole of what I have got."

options.label: You don't seem to enjoy this.

text_by_relation.close: "Oh. It's you." He relaxes about four inches and then remembers and puts them back. "Still can't come in. Sorry."
text_by_relation.familiar: "You." He nods, once, too much. "Still can't come in."
